description_en: You can invoke CreateCallTags to create multiple call tags under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用CreateCallTags在指定实例下创建多个号码标签
kebab_example: aliyun ccc create-call-tags --instance-id ccc-test --call-tag-name-list TagA_,_TagB --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCallTags

parameters.description_en: A JSON-formatted string representing an array of call tag names. Each array element is a call tag name to be created. The length of each call tag name must be between 1 and 10 characters.
parameters.description_zh: 号码标签名称列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是待创建的号码标签名称，号码标签名称的长度要求1-10个字符。
parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted string representing an array of call tag names. Each array element is a call tag name to be created. The length of each call tag name must be between 1 and 10 characters
parameters.help_zh: 号码标签名称列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是待创建的号码标签名称，号码标签名称的长度要求1-10个字符
parameters.name: call_tag_name_list
